title: ASGEND Remote API v1 — common definitions
description: Shared primitives: identifiers, timestamps, enums, limits. Contains only $defs. Normative prose: docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

api_version.description: Major API version carried at the top level of every JSON response body.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. Servers emit UTC with 'Z' and millisecond precision; consumers accept any RFC 3339 offset and 0-9 fractional digits.

task_id.description: Remote task id (rt_). Not the core task id.

core_task_id.description: Opaque task id of the local ASGEND core (the 0.9.x core generates 10 lowercase base32 chars, e.g. 'k3v9q2m7xa'; docs show 'task-...'). Never parsed; no prefix is guaranteed.

actor.description: Who performed an action: a user, a node, or the server itself.

event_id.description: Server-assigned 64-bit integer, strictly increasing per workspace (not necessarily contiguous).

event_cursor.description: Event cursor: 0 = from the beginning, otherwise an event_id already seen.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key, unique per (workspace, operation kind).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (never parsed by clients).

role.description: Workspace role. Adding a role is a breaking change (v2).

task_state.description: Remote task state. Adding a value is a breaking change (v2).

core_task_state.description: States that only an Execution Node may report (mirror of the core 'status' op).

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. New codes may be added in a minor contract revision; clients fall back to the HTTP status for unknown codes.

display_name.description: Human-readable single-line name (node, device, workspace, user).

artifact_name.description: Basename only: no '/', backslash, NUL or other control characters, not '.' or '..', at most 255 characters (servers additionally enforce <= 255 UTF-8 bytes).

mime.description: Declared media type (type/subtype with optional parameters). Advisory only: downloads are always served as attachments with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

artifact_size.description: Size in bytes; v1 limit is 256 MiB per artifact (core artifact_list limit).

task_text.description: Task prompt, 1..262144 characters (body limit 1 MiB still applies).

user_token.description: User/device bearer token. Returned exactly once, at creation.

node_token.description: Node bearer token. Returned exactly once, at enrollment/rotation.

one_time_code.description: Pairing/enrollment code as typed by a human: Crockford base32 with optional '-' or ' ' separators; servers normalize (uppercase, strip separators, I/L->1, O->0) before hashing/lookup.

closed_object_note.description: Documentation anchor. Schemas that set additionalProperties:false are grant-shaping inputs (pairing-code, node-enrollment, members PUT). Ignoring an unknown restricting field there would widen privileges, so the server rejects unknown fields with 400 invalid_request (fail closed). Everything else tolerates unknown fields.
